_about: Evaluation set (Step 8, D58): data, not code. Each case runs as one agent conversation; the expectations apply to the LAST turn. Checks are deterministic (no model judges): tools_any = one of these tools must be called ('no_tool' = none); tools_all = every one of these; outcomes = acceptable outcomes of the last tool call ('no_tool' when none ran); contains = groups of alternatives, every group must match (case-insensitive); not_contains = none may appear; not_together = no sentence may contain all terms of a pair; no_confirmed = a value that may appear only in a sentence that rejects it; sources = document (+ page) that must be cited; forbidden_docs = must never be among the candidates or evidence; single_country = every candidate is from the asked country or GLOBAL. new=true marks questions never used while building (smoke tests).
